parent_design: Q022 / AGENT-011 Treasury Failure Follow-up Design
purpose: Isolate the timing-mapping failure question by keeping the validated Q019 Treasury signal fixed while mapping the trade date from record_date to auction_date.

event_source.dataset: Q019 fixed Treasury 10-Year auction result events

timing_basis.authoritative_date_source: Q025 Treasury auction-date PIT feasibility result
timing_basis.rule: Treat the official auction_date as the fixed date-level information anchor; act only on the first XNYS session strictly after auction_date.

event_source.fixed_signal: Signed change in bid-to-cover ratio versus immediately preceding 10-Year Note auction: positive=+1, negative=-1, unchanged=0.

trading_rule.exposure: On the first eligible XNYS session strictly after auction_date, hold the unchanged Q019 event signal for that session only; outside event sessions exposure is zero.
trading_rule.mapping: +1 = equal-weight long across all fixed H2 assets; -1 = equal-weight short; 0 = flat.
trading_rule.sizing: Each active asset receives 1/N of gross exposure with total gross exposure fixed at 1.0; no leverage.
trading_rule.overlap: If multiple mapped events fall on the same session, aggregate their fixed signals by arithmetic sum and use sign(sum), with zero producing flat exposure.
trading_rule.intervention: Only change versus Q020/Q022-H1 is the event-date mapping from record_date to auction_date; signal sign and all other trading rules remain unchanged.
trading_rule.no_tuning: No threshold, holding period, asset, weighting, signal variant, horizon, leverage, or parameter search.

authorization.authorization_condition: Formal performance requires successful fresh coverage, immutable snapshot fingerprint, source-contract fingerprint match, and an explicit execution authorization created before performance computation.

interpretation: H2 is a single pre-registered timing-mapping study. The coverage discovery and Q025 date-level PIT feasibility are not performance evidence.
